result.title: CoHABIT: Complementary Evaluation of Furniture Layouts through Spatial Rules and Household Routines
result.summary: We introduce CoHABIT, a framework for evaluating furniture layouts through complementary spatial rules and household routines. Static assessment captures geometric validity, ergonomic access, functional organization, and configurable design preferences, including Feng Shui. Dynamic assessment uses learned resident policies to simulate everyday activities, resource sharing, coordination, and individual burdens in multi-agent households. Controlled comparisons show how spatial criteria and household behavior reveal distinct aspects of layout quality, while resident profiles and scheduling influence furnishing rankings. Independent verification of household needs grounds dynamic comparisons in observed outcomes, enabling interpretable assessments of how furnished environments serve different households.

AI.brief_summary: CoHABIT 提出一个家具布局评估框架，将静态空间规则（几何有效性、人体工学可达性、功能组织、含风水在内的偏好配置）与基于学习居民策略的动态居家活动模拟相结合，用于比较多户家庭的资源分配与负担。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于 3D 场景布局质量评估与居住行为模拟，虽然用策略模拟来生成评测证据，但不涉及视觉细节表征、latent 推理状态生成或模型答案对视觉证据的使用，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
